g.text: The pooled pattern reflects differences between country means

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #273747

g.text: Equal region weights. Identical 98-region samples in both years.
Covariance uses denominator N throughout, with country contributions weighted by their 51/98 and 47/98 shares.
Between-country share is an accounting decomposition, not a causal attribution or explained-variance statistic.
